R20 clockProposalsFor answers the standing proposals on a visible action, each with its key, rule, date or undetermined with why, basis, trace, label and when proposed; [] when none; control: an adopted proposal is not listed; absent or invisible is actions.noSuchAction; writes nothing

R21 the zone a day is read in is actions.actionZone (its R100), the one spelling: with two active profiles of different zones, an action addressed to an office the second gives is judged, and its items' zone answered, in the second's zone (R3, R5, R14, R19's fallback), the zone actions reads; with no zone held its days stay undetermined, never the UTC day; this module exports no actionZone of its own

R22 dueAtOf(entry, zone) is exported and pure: a timed entry with due_zone answers its own zone; one without answers the action's zone; a date-only entry answers both null; a malformed due_at answers both null

R22 R3's and R19's items carry dueAtOf's answer for each entry, the action's zone being the one they judge it in; and a member states a timed entry only as a local date-time on its own date (control: an hour 24 is CLOCK_ENTRY_REFUSED)

R23 each overdueClocks item carries venue: an office addressee answers its role and body; a kind with a venue and no office addressee answers the venue, named as the view states it; neither answers null with venue_why; R3's order, paging and other fields unchanged
R24 at most 500 actions are read, and truncated is stated

R24 clocksRunning counts the pending clock entries of visible open actions, in all and by owed_by with each one's earliest date; controls: a met entry, a resolved action's pending entry and an action the viewer cannot see are not counted; at most 500 actions are read, truncated stated; writes nothing
R24 the op clocksrunning reads the viewer from the query and answers clocksRunning's own answer
R25 action-clocks declares clockadopt: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25 action-clocks declares reminderanswer: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25 action-clocks declares reminderset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25 R26 action-clocks declares remindersfor: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, the missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused

R26 op=remindersfor answers remindersFor's own answer: a reminder a member set, read through a fresh op map; controls: an invisible and an absent action answer as an absent one, the viewer is the stamp not the body

R3 (N609) each item carries `zone`, the zone whose local day it was judged on: the addressed office's profile zone first, else the view's time_zone (actions R12), so its reader dates and ages it in the zone this module counted in

R3 (T45) each item carries owed_by and says it is a question about a date, naming no failure; while the action states reply_owed: false no entry owed_by: body is listed (control: reply_owed absent lists it)
R3 a pending entry is past from the local day after its date in the action's zone, never the UTC day (K1444 (iii)); with no zone held its lateness is undetermined and it is not listed

R3 overdueClocks lists every overdue or past pending entry of open visible actions, with the action's project and its creator; met, waived and future entries and closed actions are not listed; writes nothing
R3 pages run in (action, position) order, at most 500 entries and 500 actions a page, `cursor` and `truncated` as R1's; every entry is reached
R3 R5 the action's project is the project of the first determination among its rests_on legs that the viewer may see, read through conformance; null when it rests on none (K702)

R4 (N427) reminderRefused(arm, detail, extra?) is exported, the one answer REMINDER_REFUSED is minted through: its row, its arm and detail, a caller's extra fields never replacing them; it writes nothing and never throws
R4 R6 the ops reminderset and reminderanswer read the control plane's stamps from the query, never the body's
R4 refusals in order: MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_REMINDER, NO_SUCH_ACTION (absent, invisible, not an action alike), then REMINDER_REFUSED naming each arm
R4 reminderSet: a member sets, changes and removes their own reminder; it is a row of this module's table and the action's document is byte-identical before and after
R4 remindersFor answers an action's reminders with their entry, day, member and state (waiting, due, answered); an absent or invisible action answers actions.noSuchAction
R5 (N609) each due item carries `zone`, the zone whose local day its reminder was judged due on; an action whose zone is not held is never due, so carries none
R5 pages run in (action, entry, day) order, at most 500, `cursor` and `truncated` as R1's; every due reminder is reached once; writes nothing
R5 remindersDue lists each unanswered reminder whose day has come, on a pending entry of an open visible action: due on its local day and not before, gone once answered
R6 reminderAnswer: the member answers a due reminder with another later day, or with none; a second answer is refused; the document is unchanged

R7 (T45) a fifth basis kind, stated: a deadline the other side stated, naming who and where it is held, never presented as a legal deadline; a rule entry keeps its citation words; BASIS_KINDS exported frozen

R7 every deadline names its basis kind: rule (a law or order, which may name a held standard, its in-force state read on the date, the member's citation kept), commitment, dependency (never a violation) or window; an entry naming none reads as stating none
R7 overdue is derived at the read and a stored status is reported beside the derivation, never in place of it; a proposal carries its basis and no date is written into the record
R8 a machine never adopts a deadline, and this module's one write to an action's document is a member's adoption, which only appends: no entry is removed or re-dated
R8 nothing reminds that no member asked for; a machine never sets, changes or answers a reminder; this module never adds, removes or re-dates a clock entry
R9 every read answers an invisible action as an absent one; the module's tables are keyed by bundle_id and purge with the action; no place is named; tests run on the test profile

tests: R13 a member adopts a standing proposal in one act: the entry, with its basis and trace, is appended to clock[] by a revision of the action; the proposal is recorded adopted with who and when; from then it is tracked like any other

R13 refusals in order: MACHINE_CANNOT_ADOPT_CLOCK, NO_SUCH_ACTION, NO_SUCH_CLOCK_PROPOSAL (never proposed, or already adopted), CLOCK_PROPOSAL_UNDETERMINED, then the revision's own; nothing is written by a refusal

R7 every deadline names its basis kind: rule (a law or order, which may name a held standard, its in-force state read on the date, the member's citation kept), commitment, dependency (never a violation) or window; an entry naming none reads as stating none
R8 a machine never adopts a deadline, and this module's one write to an action's document is a member's adoption, which only appends: no entry is removed or re-dated
R13 the op clockadopt reads the control plane's stamps from the query, never the body's

R10 a business count reads the holiday entries for all offices and those naming the action's ONE office (its addressee when a named office, else its kind's venue; K986), and no other office's; never a closure list's (K1519)

R10 R12 a rule that names a closure list counts on that list alone, and the list's entry is read at its own local-facts path (list=<name>), stated by its own status apart from the office calendar's: unconfirmed, confirmed, corrected (counted on, naming its member and date, and still counted on once confirmed, N603) and disputed (N562)
R10 on the first profile's office-specific 2026 entries (M-189–M-191): each office counts on its own entry; an office no entry names, with no entry for all offices, leaves the year undetermined

R10 the count states each year's confirmation through local-facts: unconfirmed, confirmed, corrected (counting on the correction, naming its member and date), and undetermined when disputed; a calendar count states none

R11 calendarFactsRead lists, once each, the holiday entries and office hours a live business-day deadline reads, from this year to its latest pending entry's (at least the next), with the actions reading each; writes nothing

R11 (N689) calendarFactsRead also lists each entry of the named closure list a live deadline's closures or observed.closures reads, at its own list=<name> path (the one R12 reads), once each: the test profile's CPRA-like rule counts on 'town' and its observed practice names 'court', so both lists' entries are listed, each once

R11 (N689) a list a rule only rolls on is listed; a path a rule and its observed both name is listed once; a list entry for another office, a list no live deadline reads, and a rule naming a list it neither counts nor rolls on read nothing
R11 at most 500 actions are read, `truncated` stated

R11 each path's actions are answered as {action, project, created_by}, the project and creator as R3 computes them (K1000): one created by a member in a project, one by a machine in another member's project
R1 pendingClocks lists pending entries dated before `before` across visible actions, at most 500; a bad `before` is its own refusal
R1 pendingClocks reads at most 500 actions a page in id order after `after`; `cursor` is the last entry answered when `truncated`, else null; no entry is lost across pages
R1 (N311) a page runs in (action, position) order and may end inside an action: its cursor `<action>#<position>` resumes after that entry, at the page bound and across it
R1 (N311) an action with more pending clock entries than a page (500) is read whole across pages
R2 clockPropose computes from the profile's deadline through civil-time, stored apart with its trace and labelled; refusals in order; never written into clock[]
R2 a rule held without a primary source is no basis (UNMEASURED, K1445): a profile holding one does not combine, and the count itself refuses it; a sourced rule counts

R2 a business-day count runs on the profile's weekend and holiday calendar through civil-time (C-2), and is undetermined, with why, where it reaches a year the calendar does not list or the profile holds no weekend; a calendar count adds days
R2 the close of business is the governing office's close on the due day (C-4), and an uncertain due date is offered with both candidates, the group's own deadline taking the earliest (K1444 (i))
R25 action-clocks declares reminderset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25 action-clocks declares reminderanswer: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25 action-clocks declares clockadopt: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25 R26 action-clocks declares remindersfor: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, the missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused

R12 factReader answers each holiday entry as R10's count reads it, over the real local-facts: unconfirmed, confirmed, corrected (its value, says, member and day) and disputed; it writes nothing; a disputed year is "disputed in your group's Civicsmith" (DEC-149)
R12 a lapsed confirmation is unconfirmed, naming the day it was made; the count says so

R12 negative controls: an entry naming no local fact, a factStatus that throws or refuses, or an answer local-facts cannot give is absent with why; nothing is thrown; the count says it "cannot be read in your group's Civicsmith" (DEC-149)

R12 factReader answers null when localFacts has no factStatus, and the count then states its calendar not_read, saying so without calling the group's Civicsmith 'this instance' (DEC-149: "whether your group has confirmed the calendar was not read")
R12 one reader: the same count through factReader and through the count's own path (clockPropose) answers alike, at each status
R1: pendingClocksRefusal is PENDING_CLOCKS_BAD_BEFORE (C-117.5), echoing the `before` it was given

R14 clocksIcs answers one iCalendar file of the pending dated entries of the named actions: an all-day event on the entry's day in the action's zone, its summary the text, its description the basis and the action, a stable UID per (action, position); undated entries left out and counted
R14 a one-off file the member saves: no address is published, nothing is pushed; an absent or invisible action answers actions.noSuchAction; at most 200 actions
R14 the renderer: each zone's VTIMEZONE, a zone with no change held as one observance, X-WR-TIMEZONE only for one zone

R15 lateness counts the group's own entries (owed_by: group, whatever their kind, and dependencies and windows) dated in the period: met on time, met late with the days late each, still pending past their date, and the denominator, each a computed fact, naming what it could not count
R15 never a finding about government: no rule entry the group does not owe is counted, no counterparty is named, nothing is raised; a malformed period is refused

R3 overdueClocks lists every overdue or past pending entry of open visible actions, with the action's project and its creator; met, waived and future entries and closed actions are not listed; writes nothing
R3 a pending entry is past from the local day after its date in the action's zone, never the UTC day (K1444 (iii)); with no zone held its lateness is undetermined and it is not listed

R3 (N609) each item carries `zone`, the zone whose local day it was judged on: the addressed office's profile zone first, else the view's time_zone (actions R12), so its reader dates and ages it in the zone this module counted in
R3 pages run in (action, position) order, at most 500 entries and 500 actions a page, `cursor` and `truncated` as R1's; every entry is reached
R7 overdue is derived at the read and a stored status is reported beside the derivation, never in place of it; a proposal carries its basis and no date is written into the record
R9 every read answers an invisible action as an absent one; the module's tables are keyed by bundle_id and purge with the action; no place is named; tests run on the test profile
R3 R5 the action's project is the project of the first determination among its rests_on legs that the viewer may see, read through conformance; null when it rests on none (K702)
R4 reminderSet: a member sets, changes and removes their own reminder; it is a row of this module's table and the action's document is byte-identical before and after
R4 refusals in order: MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_REMINDER, NO_SUCH_ACTION (absent, invisible, not an action alike), then REMINDER_REFUSED naming each arm
R4 remindersFor answers an action's reminders with their entry, day, member and state (waiting, due, answered); an absent or invisible action answers actions.noSuchAction
R5 remindersDue lists each unanswered reminder whose day has come, on a pending entry of an open visible action: due on its local day and not before, gone once answered
R5 (N609) each due item carries `zone`, the zone whose local day its reminder was judged due on; an action whose zone is not held is never due, so carries none
R5 pages run in (action, entry, day) order, at most 500, `cursor` and `truncated` as R1's; every due reminder is reached once; writes nothing
R6 reminderAnswer: the member answers a due reminder with another later day, or with none; a second answer is refused; the document is unchanged
R8 nothing reminds that no member asked for; a machine never sets, changes or answers a reminder; this module never adds, removes or re-dates a clock entry
